outcome: Number of pregnant people admitted to jail
Birth outcomes (live births, preterm births, cesarean deliveries)
cohort: Pregnant people admitted to six U.S. jails over a 12-month period
finding: Approximately 3% of female jail admissions involved pregnancy, and of pregnancies ending in custody, 64% were live births, with a cesarean delivery rate of 33% and preterm birth rate of 8%.
mod_finding: One-third of births to women in jail were cesarean deliveries.
